Zacchæus in the Sycamore Tree

Richard Crashaw (W.) (c. 1613–1649)

L
UKE
 
XIX.
 4
.
W
HY
 of strange fruits dost boast, O sycamore?
Of leaves not thine who gave thee such a store?
He who waves to and fro on bough of thine,
A cluster soon will be of the True Vine.
